# WF-08 worked example: archive authorization without an existence oracle
Fixture grants `auditor-1` a `cross_agent_archive` selector for `agent-a/profile-a/session-7`, up to checkpoint 4. The auditor requests `agent-a/profile-a/session-9`, outside the selector: the controller returns `404 not_found`, exactly as it does for a nonexistent archive, and writes a deny audit with the selector and grant id. It never reveals that session 9 exists.
The archive service is then unavailable. The same request returns `503 archive_unavailable`, never an empty successful page. Finally, `manager-1` has `archive.grant_use` but no `archive.read` use for the target; its attempt to issue a usable delegated read is denied and audited. No archive payload, source-host login, objective, or report side effect is created.
